[[File:Devon Hubner.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Devon Hubner.]]
'''Devon Hubner''' (1978 – 1 February 2024) was head of Infrastructure Operations for the Players Committee from 2020 until his death.<ref name="memorial">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/remembering-devon-hubner-1978-2024/ Remembering Devon Hubner (1978-2024)], starwarsccg.org (5 February 2024). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/remembering-devon-hubner-1978-2024.html swccg.com snapshot]</ref> He was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 14 from Chesterfield, NH. The fan site's Squadron Members table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
